interpretation: the 3k/6k milestone exact_fill scores were invalid because of the rotation and exact_fill bugs; they cannot be used to judge the training

with the fixed eval the 6k checkpoint still does not grasp: translation is in range (dp 0.023-0.045, eef path 0.67-1.21 m) but rotation stays small (0.0007, 0.0045 with FiLM bypass) and the gripper closes without aligning

the F2 FiLM has a strong effect at eval: bypassing it increases motion and rotation but drops the close fraction from 97.5% to 31.8%; with FiLM the policy is 'close and barely move' when the force history is no-contact
therefore the 6k result is a model/FiLM generalization issue, not a data issue (force scale verified 1.45 N) and not just the eval bug
